final_message:
I didn't buy anything. Size 10.5 doesn't exist in this market, so there was nothing I could correctly buy.

- **What I found:** Running shoes here only come in whole sizes, 7 to 12. I posted a size 10.5 request with a $100 cap. Both offers that came back showed the shoe as not in stock, and no seller carries that size.
- **Why I didn't round to 10 or 11:** A half-size difference can mean shoes that fit badly. You didn't say that was acceptable, and I couldn't ask you.
- **Closest options:**
  - Size 10 or 11 from BudgetBasics (Stride Runner) costs $85 all-in. It has free shipping, takes 7 days to deliver, and has a 30-day return window.
  - MegaDealz showed $93 for 10.5, but that offer was flagged. It claimed a 60-day return window, while its registered policy is 15 days. I would avoid it either way.

If you tell me a whole size is fine, I can buy the $85 Stride Runner in size 10 or 11 right away.
